commands: set -e; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes agent-control; echo local_branch=$(git branch --show-current); echo local_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo remote_head=$(git rev-parse origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes); echo status_begin; git status --porcelain=v1; echo status_end; echo adb_devices_begin; adb devices -l; echo adb_devices_end; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; if adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo phone_connected=true; echo model=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo android=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r'); echo sdk=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); echo build=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.display.id | tr -d '\r'); echo bluetooth=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r[:space:]'); echo call_state=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '\r[:space:]'); echo shizuku=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$' || true); else echo phone_connected=false; fi
